briefdescription.para: The top-level module defining the general-purpose C++ template hypergraph library.

detaileddescription.para: This module provides a comprehensive suite of memory-efficient hypergraph representations, highly customizable algorithms, and robust I/O facilities. Designed strictly around modern C++ paradigms, the library leverages templates and concepts to deliver an API that is fast, generic, and type-safe. It supports both undirected hypergraphs and backward-forward (bf) directed hypergraphs.
